description: Watch one Robinhood Chain wallet for your agent (its own wallet, or one it trades with): Toll POSTs a signed JSON event to your https url when the wallet gives a new token approval (ERC-20, NFT approval-for-all or Permit2, with the spender and whether the amount is unlimited), signs a new EIP-7702 delegation, or receives a token whose Toll check is against; and, when the address is a smart account (a Safe, a Zodiac Roles or Delay module, an ERC-7579 account), when who can move its funds changes (event account_permission: a module enabled, a guard or fallback handler set, a signer or threshold change, a Zodiac role or permission, the Delay waiting period, an ERC-7579 module installed; each with a severity and plain words). Answers the watch id and, the first time, the secret that signs every event (x-toll-signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, raw body)>). Each approval alert names the spender and amount so it can be revoked. Needs a Toll key; wallet watches have their own cap, the same size as your tier's coin watches (3 / 20 / 50 / 100 by $TOLL held). Facts, not advice.
